description: && ignores an error in its second operand when the first is false
notes: The spec gives logic operators no short-circuit rule (the conditional operator section, by contrast, says when errors are suppressed), so the plain reading reports this error. hashicorp/hcl evaluates both operands and converts each to bool before its short-circuit check (BinaryOpExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression_ops.go): the undefined variable leaves an unknown value, which converts, and the ShortCircuit function of OpLogicalAnd then returns the result with only the left operand's errors. A failed operand that doesn't convert to bool, such as a failed addition, is still reported.
